level: K-67 Vertical Slice â€” Hangar Intake
notes: GATING: Sealed exit = card reader (badge) + power-cut door that must be PRIED. Badge is on the dead guard. Booth SEC DOOR is badge-locked from inside, so the grate is the only first entry. Picking up badge+pistol scripts Pete's vent breach. Early exit attempt: reader flashes NO, Kael notes a pry bar won't beat a Class-A maglock.
LOCKDOWN: visual only â€” red light, klaxon, kiosk screen flips to LOCKDOWN, exit status strip goes hard red. Nothing mechanical closes.

ART (decals, later): OSL-yellow guide lanes tracing the routine leg, worn bare at kiosk; PAD 01 floor stencil; oil stain under forklift + charging cable to wall; booth face signage 'SECURITY - LEVEL 1 CLEARANCE' + blank DAYS-SINCE-INCIDENT poster; ration wrappers by cot.

VENT / WHY IT EXISTS: the hangar cycles atmosphere every time the intake door opens, so it NEEDS a big air-handling duct â€” the vent is the atmo intake for the pressurization system, the most structurally justified object in the room. STORY LINK: the bio-crate pressure spike vents into that duct system; what crawls back OUT of the duct is Pete. The disaster travels through the station's own infrastructure. Placement above the crates also stages the beat-7 fight in the aisles.
OVERHEAD (dashed on map): gantry crane rail with hanging hook across crate zone. Ceiling heights TBD â€” 3D heights are generator defaults in gen_walkthrough.py / gen_blender.py.

CAMERA: fixed oblique, no rotation. Booth annexed off the hangar's NORTH wall so its whole south face (kiosk, grate, window, sec door) is camera-visible. Free-standing interactables face south with standing room below.

STORY: booth reads as sealed dead infrastructure on the routine leg. Dead guard (beat 6) is the first evidence ANY other personnel exist, or that OSL arms anyone. The cot says he was STATIONED here, living in the box, watching her floor.

beats.label: Routine landing â€” disembark, Miller intro
beats.objective: Follow the yellow guide lane to the check-in Kiosk.

dialogue.speaker: miller
dialogue.name: DIRECTOR MILLER
dialogue.text: Associate Laura. Welcome aboard K-67. I'm Director Miller.

dialogue.speaker: miller
dialogue.name: DIRECTOR MILLER
dialogue.text: Yours is the only arrival this quarter, so intake will be brief. I expect efficiency.

dialogue.speaker: miller
dialogue.name: DIRECTOR MILLER
dialogue.text: Kael will handle your orientation. Kael, dear, mind on the work today, hmm?

dialogue.speaker: kael
dialogue.name: KAEL
dialogue.text: ...Copy that, Vivian.

dialogue.speaker: kael
dialogue.name: KAEL
dialogue.text: (sighs) Sorry about her, Laura. Let's get you processed. Stretch your legs a little.

dialogue.speaker: kael
dialogue.name: KAEL
dialogue.text: Good. Check-in kiosk is on the security module. Follow the yellow lane.

beats.label: Kiosk â€” clearance check
beats.objective: Retrieve an Industrial Prying Tool from the maintenance alcove (East wall).

dialogue.speaker: terminal
dialogue.name: KIOSK TERMINAL
dialogue.text:
[ CREDENTIAL SCAN... VERIFIED ]
[ ASSOCIATE: LAURA - CLEARANCE LEVEL 1 ]
[ ASSIGNED TASK: INBOUND CARGO INSPECTION - BAY 2 ]

dialogue.speaker: kael
dialogue.name: KAEL
dialogue.text: You're in. First thing to know: this station is a relic. Mag-locks stick on every gate.

dialogue.speaker: kael
dialogue.name: KAEL
dialogue.text: Grab a prying tool off the maintenance rack, east wall, past the big sealed door. Trust me, you'll use it daily.

beats.label: Tool rack â€” grab prying tool (pass sealed exit)
beats.objective: Inspect the seals on the Bio-Crates in the center aisle.

dialogue.speaker: laura
dialogue.name: LAURA
dialogue.text: Industrial pry bar. Standard-issue OSL junk.

dialogue.speaker: kael
dialogue.name: KAEL
dialogue.text: That's the one. Now the actual job: those bio-crates by the north wall came in unmarked last cycle.

dialogue.speaker: kael
dialogue.name: KAEL
dialogue.text: The Director wants the seals checked before they ship deeper into the station. Have a look.

beats.label: Bio-crates â€” the crisis
beats.objective: EMERGENCY: Containment breach! Check the security module crawl grate.

dialogue.speaker: kael
dialogue.name: KAEL
dialogue.text: The crate's vibrating. It's radiating a dry, metallic heat.

dialogue.speaker: kael
dialogue.name: KAEL
dialogue.text: That's... weird. My sensors are spiking.

dialogue.speaker: kael
dialogue.name: KAEL
dialogue.text: Laura, step back. I'm reading a pressure build that...

dialogue.speaker: miller
dialogue.name: DIRECTOR MILLER
dialogue.text: Laura! What did you do?!

dialogue.speaker: miller
dialogue.name: DIRECTOR MILLER
dialogue.text: I'm seeing a containment breach in Sector 1. Initiating safety lockdown immediately.

dialogue.speaker: miller
dialogue.name: DIRECTOR MILLER
dialogue.text: Nobody leaves until I find the leak.

beats.label: Lockdown â€” pry the grate (sec door badge-locked)
beats.objective: Pry the crawl grate and breach the Security Booth.

dialogue.speaker: kael
dialogue.name: KAEL
dialogue.text: Vivian? Vivian, the override... she cut my override.

dialogue.speaker: kael
dialogue.name: KAEL
dialogue.text: Laura, listen to me. She's not sealing the leak in. She's sealing YOU in with it.

dialogue.speaker: kael
dialogue.name: KAEL
dialogue.text: The security module, there's a crawl grate on its face. Old maintenance access. Pry it and get inside. GO.

beats.label: Guard â€” badge + pistol (scripts Pete)
beats.objective: Armed up! Return through the booth and prepare for combat.

dialogue.speaker: kael
dialogue.name: KAEL
dialogue.text: A GUARD? Laura, there is no one else stationed on K-67. There hasn't been for two years. I read the manifests.

dialogue.speaker: laura
dialogue.name: LAURA
dialogue.text: He has a cot in here. Ration wrappers. He LIVED in this box.

dialogue.speaker: laura
dialogue.name: LAURA
dialogue.text: ...He has a sidearm. And a security badge.

dialogue.speaker: kael
dialogue.name: KAEL
dialogue.text: Watching your floor, this whole time... Take both. Miller's gone completely silent on my end, and I don't like it.

beats.label: Seared breach + fight in the aisles
beats.objective: Eliminate the Seared threat. Proceed to the Sealed Exit.

dialogue.speaker: kael
dialogue.name: KAEL
dialogue.text: Pressure spike, the atmo duct! Something is IN the duct...

dialogue.speaker: kael
dialogue.name: KAEL
dialogue.text: It's coming out of the vent. Laura, the crates, get to cover and put that pistol to work!

dialogue.speaker: kael
dialogue.name: KAEL
dialogue.text: ...Pete. God, that was Pete. Two years on this rock and nobody told me he was still...

dialogue.speaker: kael
dialogue.name: KAEL
dialogue.text: OSL doesn't misplace a person for two years, Laura. They buried him and kept billing his badge.

dialogue.speaker: miller
dialogue.name: DIRECTOR MILLER
dialogue.text: Casualty logged. Regrettable, but the leak takes priority, Associate. Proceed to the sealed exit.

dialogue.speaker: kael
dialogue.name: KAEL
dialogue.text: ...Don't listen to her. Just move. Please.

beats.label: Badge kills maglock â€” pry the dead exit
beats.objective: Sector 1 Cleared. Enter the Central Elevator Shaft (Descend to Floor 2).

denied_dialogue.speaker: terminal
denied_dialogue.name: SEALED EXIT TERMINAL
denied_dialogue.text: [ MAINTENANCE SPINE â€” ACCESS DENIED â€” SEC-1 BADGE REQUIRED ]

denied_dialogue.speaker: kael
denied_dialogue.name: KAEL
denied_dialogue.text: Class-A maglock. Don't bother, Lauraâ€”your pry bar would snap before it moves.

denied_dialogue.speaker: kael
denied_dialogue.name: KAEL
denied_dialogue.text: Weird, though. Nobody on this station is supposed to be badged for security. Nobody's here.

dialogue.speaker: terminal
dialogue.name: DOOR TERMINAL
dialogue.text: [ SEC-1 BADGE ACCEPTED â€” MAGLOCK RELEASED ]

dialogue.speaker: kael
dialogue.name: KAEL
dialogue.text: Lock's dead, but Vivian cut the power, so the door won't move on its own. The old way, Laura. Pry it.

dialogue.speaker: miller
dialogue.name: DIRECTOR MILLER
dialogue.text: Associate. You are outside your designated safety zone. Return to the hangar immediately.

dialogue.speaker: miller
dialogue.name: DIRECTOR MILLER
dialogue.text: I... I cannot guarantee your safety if you continue. The thermal breach is... expanding.

dialogue.speaker: kael
dialogue.name: KAEL
dialogue.text: Get through the door, Laura! Into the central elevator shaft! GO!
